Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arom usually hope their child will grow to embody sweet fragrance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name Arom can be seen as a reflection of the cultural appreciation for fragrances and their ability to uplift and soothe the senses.
